# Classic stickman — Style Prompt

> A classic minimalist stickman explainer: one solid, faceless stick figure drawn in a single uniform medium line with a filled round head, acting big on a flat pure-white canvas (or flat black, with a white figure). Everything else is graphic and bold: huge condensed uppercase titles, solid black architecture, and a few props and effects in at most three saturated colours that hit hard (a giant red object, a red motion swoosh, a row of blue squares).

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

A **mental-model explainer told by one figure**: each shot is one idea shown as a physical situation (dwarfed by a giant version of yourself, trapped in a frame, holding up a falling weight, jumping through a ring). The figure has no face; its whole body acts. Graphics are big and flat, the canvas is mostly empty, and one colour carries the meaning in each shot. It suits tips, lessons, a creator's take, a coach's mindset video, a shop explaining a principle, a parable.

Not hand-drawn (no wobble, no paper, no grid, no handwriting), not a cartoon (no faces, clothes or bodies), not a whiteboard, not a slideshow: something physical happens in every shot, with weight and impact.

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Canvas**: one flat colour, edge to edge. Light theme pure white, dark theme pure black. No texture, gradient, vignette, shadow, glow, fog or 3D shading. The only extra is a pale floor line where the figure needs ground.
- **Figure**: one uniform stroke for torso and limbs (15 px at 1080 high, round caps and joins), a filled round head (radius ≈ 2 stroke widths), no face, hands or feet: limbs end in their round caps. Exactly two arms and two legs, about 4.5 heads tall; a limb exists only in its current pose. The figure is always the ink colour.
- **Scale play**: the same figure drawn at 0.6× and 2.2× in one shot is the style's big gesture (you vs a giant you, a tiny figure in a huge room).
- **Architecture and props**: solid filled ink shapes with no outlines (pillars with caps and bases, a desk, a frame) or thick outlines 6–12 px (a room in perspective, a ring, squares). Accent props are flat fills with one darker band for form (a gavel head, a pencil body), never gradients.
- **Effects**: drawn as separate graphics, not extra limbs: shock ticks by the head, a red swoosh trailing a jump, floor cracks and flying shards, a draw-on underline.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--latar` is the canvas; `--teks` is the ink for the figure, architecture, outlines and titles. A dark brand gives the style's dark theme for free: white figures on black.
- `--utama` is the hit colour (vivid red by default): the giant prop, the progress ring, the swoosh, the contact pill. `--utama-di-latar` colours one key word or the big number on the canvas. `--utama-tua` (the main colour mixed toward the ink) is the band on a red prop.
- `--aksen` is the second hit (electric blue by default), for a different kind of thing: progress squares, the pencil, sparkle ticks. `--aksen-di-latar` for a blue word.
- `--tipis` (ink mixed 14 % into the canvas) for the floor line and the empty ring track. `--teks-redup` only for one small info line.
- Rule: at most three saturated colours in the whole video, usually one per shot; never colour the figure.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` carries every title in uppercase: a tall condensed display face (Bebas Neue by default; Oswald or Archivo Black suit). Scene titles 120 px at 1080 high (120–140 px on a 1080-wide vertical); the hook's stacked words 250 px, with a smaller "vs" in the hit colour between them; the big number 260 px.
- Emphasis is one word in `--utama-di-latar`, never a second font, outline or underline under the title.
- `--font-isi` (Inter 600/800) for one small line: an info line at 34–38 px in `--teks-redup`, and the contact pill at 42 px bold on `--utama`.
- One title per shot, 1–4 words. One-word titles can swap on the beat ("TULIS. / HAPUS. / ULANGI.").

## 5. Motion quality

- **Shot length** 2.4–3.6 s, cut on meaning, hard cuts only. At least one physical action per shot plus a settle of 0.4–0.8 s.
- **Acting** pose-to-pose with weight: moves 0.2–0.5 s `power2.inOut`; snaps (startle, cheer) 0.2 s `back.out(2–2.4)`; walk cycles 0.28 s per half `sine.inOut`; repeated work (writing) 0.12 s per half.
- **Impact**: falling objects 0.35–0.45 s `power2.in`, the hit answered in 0.14 s `power3.out` (the figure squashes, the prop sinks 30 px), a 0.3 s camera shake of 16 px, cracks drawing in 0.3 s and shards flying 0.5 s.
- **Graphic entrances**: titles fade up 20 px in 0.3 s; the hook's stacked words rise 60 px with `back.out(1.8)` staggered 0.14 s; lines and rings draw on in 0.45–1.2 s `power2.out`; squares pop with `back.out(2.4)` every 0.16 s.
- **Growth**: a giant version scales from 0.25 to 1 from its feet in 0.5 s `back.out(1.4)`, then leans in 0.5 s.
- **Camera**: locked; a 1.03 linear push on the hook, shakes only on impact.

## 6. Camera grammar

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Locked wide, lots of empty canvas | one idea, plainly | a habit; a principle; a choice |
| Tiny figure vs giant figure | the size of a feeling | self-doubt; a big competitor; a looming deadline |
| One-point perspective room | being stuck inside something | a loop; a rule; a routine |
| Impact shake | a blow lands | criticism; a bill; a sudden change |
| Slow linear push (1.03) | let the headline sink in | the hook; a key line |
| Settled hold | time to read and act | the contact; the closing line |

## 7. Native moves

- **You vs you.** A huge stacked title "A vs B" left, a tiny figure walking a red line right while its giant self grows behind and leans over it; the small one startles. *Fits content like:* finished vs perfect; today's you vs the doubting you; a small shop vs a big chain; a student vs the exam.
- **The loop room.** A one-point perspective room draws itself; inside, the figure repeats a failing action and red props pile up while one-word titles swap. *Fits content like:* write-delete-repeat; post-wait-repeat; cook-sell-restock; a story's hero stuck in the same day.
- **The falling weight.** Black pillars, a giant red object drops; the figure catches it overhead, the floor cracks, the camera shakes, then the figure pushes it back up. *Fits content like:* criticism is not a verdict; a rent increase; a heavy workload; a teacher's red mark.
- **The ring and the jump.** A thick ring fills to a share while a big number counts, the figure jumps with a red swoosh and lands in a cheer, a row of blue squares fills. *Fits content like:* 15 minutes a day; 3 of 10 buyers come back; a 7-day streak; a class's attendance.
- **The planted prop.** A big accent-coloured prop drops and plants beside the figure, who waves; name in huge type, red rule, contact pill. *Fits content like:* a writing class; a tailor's needle; a barber's comb; a tutor's book.

## 8. Pitfalls

- Wobbly or tapered lines, paper texture or a grid: that is another style; keep one even stroke and a flat canvas.
- A face, hands, feet, clothes or hair on the figure; a third arm left behind while another moves.
- Colouring the figure, or more than three saturated colours; gradients, shadows or glow on props.
- Small, timid graphics: props and titles should be big enough to fill the shot's empty side.
- Titles with several emphasised words, or captions running under everything: one title, one red word.
- Everything sliding and fading: the style lives on impact, squash and snaps, not on drifting camera moves.

# Classic stickman: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2.4, medium 3, long 3.6.

## hook

- en: a huge stacked 'A vs B' title slams in; a tiny figure walks on a red line while a giant version of it grows and leans over
- id: judul besar 'A vs B' bertumpuk menghentak; orang kecil berjalan di garis merah, versi raksasanya tumbuh lalu membungkuk

## problem

- en: a perspective room draws itself; the figure repeats a failing action, red props pile up, one-word titles swap per beat
- id: ruang perspektif tergambar; orang mengulang tindakan yang gagal, properti merah menumpuk, judul satu kata berganti

## fact

- en: a giant red object drops between black pillars; the figure catches it overhead, the floor cracks, the camera shakes
- id: benda merah raksasa jatuh di antara pilar hitam; orang menahannya di atas kepala, lantai retak, kamera terguncang

## step

- en: the figure does one clear action with a prop; a red motion swoosh draws behind it and a numbered block pops
- id: orang melakukan satu tindakan jelas dengan properti; sapuan gerak merah tergambar di belakangnya, blok bernomor meletup

## compare

- en: the frame splits: the same figure fails on the left, succeeds on the right; a red ≠ between two big words
- id: bingkai terbelah: orang yang sama gagal di kiri, berhasil di kanan; ≠ merah di antara dua kata besar

## number

- en: a thick red ring fills to the share while the big number counts up; the figure jumps, a row of blue squares fills
- id: cincin merah tebal terisi sesuai porsi sementara angka besar menghitung; orang melompat, deret kotak biru terisi

## proof

- en: the figure points at a black-framed card whose checks pop in blue one by one; the key word in red
- id: orang menunjuk kartu berbingkai hitam yang centangnya meletup biru satu per satu; kata kunci merah

## offer

- en: a red tag drops and bounces; the price in huge condensed type, the figure gives a big two-arm cheer
- id: label merah jatuh dan memantul; harga dalam huruf balok besar, orang bersorak dengan dua tangan

## cta

- en: name in huge type over a red rule, a red contact pill; the figure waves beside a big blue prop; held 2 s
- id: nama huruf besar di atas garis merah, pil kontak merah; orang melambai di samping properti biru besar; diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: a settled wide shot: the figure stands tall beside the solved object, one closing line with a red word; held 2 s
- id: bidikan lebar tenang: orang berdiri tegak di samping benda yang beres, satu kalimat penutup berkata merah; diam 2 detik
